info.title: CipherHorizon API
info.summary: Cryptographic estate: systems, certificates, imports, correlation, ranking and export.
info.description: Hand-maintained. A test fails when a registered route is missing here or a documented route does not exist. Every route but /api/v1/health needs the bearer token when the server was started with one. Every state-changing request must send the header X-Requested-With: cipherhorizon and application/json (text/csv on one route).

get.summary: The cited evaluation of a scan. For an SSH server it has no hygiene score (score -1); it carries baseline, the conformance to an SSH baseline: baseline id, title, judged, meets, changes (each with kind, name, action remove|add|upgrade|replace-key, text, cite), requires (each with id, text, met, detail, cite) and sshdConfig, the sshd_config lines that would make the server meet it.

This document.
The system's private CA bundle: fingerprint, subject, expiry, who added it and when.

post.summary: Add CA certificates to the system's private bundle. Body {"pem": "..."} (at most 64 KiB, 50 anchors per system). Certificates only: an upload containing a private-key block is refused unread, and non-CA certificates are refused. The latest scan of each of the system's endpoints is re-evaluated.

delete.summary: Remove one anchor from the system's bundle (audited); its endpoints are re-evaluated.

get.summary: The server-wide private CA bundle (--ca-bundle), read-only.
Each bundled reference list (root stores, CT logs, DH groups, lifetime limits): source, retrieval date, count, licence, age and whether it is stale.

The SSH baselines this server judges SSH servers against: id, title, version, the allowed algorithms per kind (each with the OpenSSH version that first offers it and its citation), the requirements and the minimum RSA host key size.

post.summary: Recompute a completed scan's evaluation from its stored report with the current anchors, reference data and time. The report is never rewritten; a scan event records the old and new evaluation versions.
